stations.title: Winnie
stations.say: One leaflet for each dog owner.

stations.title: owners
stations.text: A join lists an owner once for each dog.

stations.title: Your queries
stations.gap: A query that asks a query

captions: The dog food supplier sends a leaflet to every owner with a dog, one each.
A join lists an owner once for every dog, so an owner with two dogs gets two leaflets.
You put a query inside a query, in four tasks.
Now every dog owner is on the list once, and the leaflets go out.
Same tables, now asked in two steps at once.
